title: Venezuelans react to Maduro's capture and what's next
summary: In Caracas, Venezuela, residents rushed to grocery stores, pharmacies and gas stations to stock up following former President Nicolás Maduro's arrest, unsure what will happen next. Supporters for Maduro made their voices heard, while some of those who fled the regime expressed skepticism of interim President Delcy Rodriguez. Lilia Luciano has more.
